snippet.title: Ghost Vanguard AlphaTrailer
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2577430/Ghost_Vanguard/

Ghost Vanguard is a Beat'em Up game that combines stylish action with roguelike elements. Grab your sword and step into treacherous evil dungeons, using stylish and magnificent combos to defeat the sinister forces from the darkness!

Copyright WOMBO COMBO GAMES 2023
